entry.title: Join us!
entry.content:
🎯 [RECRUITING RESEARCH MEMBERS] - FIL Research Group | ANSA Lab

Supervisor: Assoc. Prof. Nguyen Huu Thanh, School of Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Hanoi University of Science and Technology
📌 Application Deadline: 11:59 PM, August 31, 2025

Are you a student from Cohort K68-K70 of the School of Electrical and Electronic Engineering?

🔥 Are you passionate about research in communication networks, cloud computing, AI technologies, and cybersecurity?
🔥 Do you want to participate in academic research projects, gain opportunities to study abroad or work internationally, receive in-depth training, and be mentored by experienced professors and researchers?
👉 This is your chance!

HIGHLIGHTED RESEARCH DIRECTIONS

💡 Distributed AI: Researching large-scale AI infrastructure deployment and security in edge-cloud computing environments.
💡 Cloud Network Security: Researching and implementing methods to detect and mitigate DDoS attacks in cloud computing environments.
💡 Edge-Cloud Computing: Researching and implementing optimization algorithms and reinforcement learning to improve the performance of distributed serverless systems.
💡 5G/6G Network Slicing: Researching and developing platforms integrating optimization and reinforcement learning algorithms to optimize resource management in 5G/6G network slicing systems.

BENEFITS OF JOINING THE LAB

🔑 Training and development in research-related skills, career orientation in AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), programming in C/C++ and Python, and technical writing.
🔑 Access to modern infrastructure for network research purposes.
🔑 Participation in training courses and seminars on cutting-edge science, technology, and engineering topics hosted by the research group.
🔑 Opportunities to co-author scientific papers and publish in prestigious conferences and journals.
🔑 Dedicated support and mentorship from faculty and lab members.
🔑 Participation in large projects in collaboration with domestic and international companies and organizations.
🔑 Opportunities for studying abroad or working overseas after graduation.
🔑 Participation in recreational activities and team-building events designed to foster collaboration and research skills.

REQUIREMENTS

📝 Be a student from cohort K68–K70 of the Electronics and Telecommunications major, School of Electrical and Electronic Engineering.
📝 Have a passion for research, enjoy self-learning and exploration, especially in networking, cloud computing, and AI.
📝 Be responsible and committed to assigned tasks.
📝 Be able to read English technical documents (holding certificates like TOEIC, IELTS is a plus).
📝 Have programming skills in at least one of the following languages: C/C++, Python, Golang, etc.

🌟 BONUS POINTS

💯 CPA (Cumulative Point Average) >= 3.0
💯 Intention to pursue graduate studies abroad or a Master’s degree at HUST
💯 Basic knowledge in areas such as Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Reinforcement Learning, etc.
💯 Experience with Linux-based systems and programming: multithreading, network programming, bash scripting.
💯 Holding international language certificates like IELTS, TOEIC, etc.
💯 Awards or achievements in high school academic competitions.

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

📌 Your application should include:

  • CV (specify your intended research direction)
  • Academic transcript downloaded from the student portal (CTT website)

📧 Send to: fil.tuyendung@husteduvn.onmicrosoft.com
📌 Email subject line: FIL2025_YourName_StudentID
📅 Deadline: 11:59 PM, August 31, 2025

📣 Contact & Learn More:

  • Fanpage: FIL Research Group, ANSA Laboratory
  • Location: Room E.711, Building C7, School of Electrical and Electronic Engineering, HUST
  • Email: fil.tuyendung@husteduvn.onmicrosoft.com
